prompts.kit:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TRANSPARENT production pixel-art UI sprite sheet for the ORIGINAL fighting game ASH HARBOR / 烬港斗魂.
Reference image is STYLE AND PALETTE ONLY, do not reproduce the screenshot. Create a 1024x1024 transparent PNG, exactly TWO columns by FOUR rows, each cell512x256 pixels. ONE isolated component per cell, all fully inside own cell with transparent space. NO lettering or numbers anywhere.
Style: beautiful authored 1990s arcade pixel art, weathered midnight-blue lacquer, aged bronze bevels, restrained jade and ember highlights, tiny wave-scroll carvings only on edges. Every visible pixel is a crisp 4x4 square, no antialias, NO gradients, NO blur, NO soft glow. Will be sampled down to a 256x256 game atlas, so readable silhouettes and precise low-resolution details. Consistent 1-logical-pixel outer outline, 2-pixel bevel. Squared cut corners. The interiors must be dark flat navy for text.
Cell row1 col1: NORMAL long rectangular menu button, 448x96 pixels, centered in cell. Narrow antique bronze rim, inset dark navy face, small teal corner accents, a little shadow underneath. Empty central text area.
Cell row1 col2: SELECTED version of EXACT SAME long button at exactly same size, gold rim, brighter warm brass bevel, tiny red-orange corner accents, dark interior. Empty center.
Cell row2 col1: LEFT PLAYER health HUD frame, 496x144 pixels centered. Long horizontal deep navy lacquer plaque with antique brass border, a subtle wave carving at left, top half reserved as empty dark navy name area. Bottom third has one long EMPTY flat black horizontal health-bar trough, 448x24 pixels, with a 1 logical pixel border. No portraits, no text.
Cell row2 col2: RIGHT PLAYER version of EXACT SAME health HUD frame, same dimensions and layout, mirrored decorative corners, jade-bronze rim instead of gold. Same EMPTY health trough.
Cell row3 col1: EMPTY modal/menu panel, 448x224 pixels, centered. Flat midnight navy interior, slim bronze double-line rectangular border with chamfered corners, tiny restrained brass wave ornaments at corners only. All center space empty. No bars or separators.
Cell row3 col2: one idle action-button tile, 112x112 pixels centered. Octagonal-square dark navy face, brass bevel, teal inset rim. Empty center large enough for a Chinese glyph. Transparent outside.
Cell row4 col1: one PRESSED action-button tile, same112x112 dimensions and shape, gold-orange lit bevel, darker recessed navy face. Empty center.
Cell row4 col2: one directional pad, 224x224 pixels centered. Classic four-way cross silhouette, dark navy lacquer, bronze beveled border. A small ivory triangular arrow built of square pixels on each of the four arms, teal central diamond. No circles, no letters.
All EIGHT components on real transparent background. Not a presentation or mockup. No labels, no gridlines, no extra objects, no scenery. Restrained and functional game art, NOT generic rounded modern UI.
prompts.digits:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art numerical sprite atlas for ASH HARBOR original arcade fighter.
Produce exactly 1024x512 transparent PNG, FIVE columns by TWO rows, ten uniform cells. Each cell204.8x256. Center ONE numeral in each cell. Read left to right row1 exactly: 0 1 2 3 4. Row2 exactly: 5 6 7 8 9. Ten isolated digits, no other characters.
Design: bold condensed slanted 1990s fighting game timer numerals, warm ivory face, antique gold 1-pixel bevel, dark indigo heavy pixel outline and small ember-orange hard drop shadow. Every source pixel cluster strictly 8x8 source pixels; no antialias, no texture noise, no soft glow or blur, no gradients. Intended final each digit about14x20 logical pixels. Same cap height, baseline, slant and stroke weight for ALL TEN digits; 1 must be a single numeral not two strokes. 0 closed loop, 8 two counters, 6 and9 distinct,4 clearly open. Generous transparent margins within all cells. This is production sprite artwork, NOT a font sample poster. No labels, no grid lines, no background.
